principle_violations.reason: This code violates the Single Responsibility Principle because the order is responsible for both order management and payment. There is also a breach of the Single Responsibility Principle because the order is responsible for both prices and quantities.
principle_violations.suggestion: Split the Order class into three separate classes: one for the payment (e.g. PaymentProcessor), one for the order quantities and one for the prices.
